text: We're new to the area and every time we have driven by the smell of the meat smoking had us saying one of these days we need to try it. Last night we finally stopped and the we are glad that we did. Actually got to meet Robert, he took our order and offered advice on what to order. Food came out really quick, the bag felt really heavy and the smell of the BBQ on the ride home about drove us crazy. The food was excellent and portion sizes were huge. My wife our resident brisket expert was impressed, lean, moist, & juicy were her comments. I did the half chicken and it was enormous and smoked to perfection. The hot sauce had just enough kick, and the sides were tasty. Well done Robert, we will be back!
They say to eat where the locals eat and we were lucky enough to do just that. Darling little place with delicious breakfast food.

If you're a true vegan don't go here. The atmosphere is great and so are the beers and super dog friendly. The only problem is they don't remake things when they mess up. I've ordered the hummus and veggies many times without cheese and when it comes out with cheese they just scrape it off and send it back out. Inappropriate as you can still see bits of cheese around the hummus. I have also ordered the vegan patty with vegan cheese and it has come out with pepper jack and upon sending it back and getting a new one you can tell they just scraped it off as there are still traces of the pepper jack. Not ok. Honestly if a restaurant messes up its their responsibility to send it out the right way.
The last few times we ordered from there it was really greasy period every time you order online then go through the drive-thru, they have no idea what you're talking about.

Excellent service. They were closed for a while because of the COVID19 pandemic, but recently reopened. Temporarily you can only eat outdoors, but the experience was magnificent. Very helpful staff, and mouth-watering food. They even bring a large bottle of hand sanitizer to every table. Magnificent restaurant with unique concept. They have unique hotdogs with inspiration and flavor from all over the world

The first time was really good. Today I went back and ordered the same thing, Pulled Pork Sandwich, mac n cheese and baked beans. I got a sandwhich full of fat scraps..I have to drive so far to get to tgis restaurant, its not worth the gas money to go back..I am so disappointed. I will have to find another bbq place. And there was a strip of metal in my food

Once again Yelp finds a great place for us. Both the wife and I had wonderful meals. She the fried shrimp and I had the NOLA BBQ shrimp over rigatoni. It's one of those selections that the next time I go there I will in all likelihood get the same thing

This place is very close to my work, and so might be a commonly visited place for me.  The food was perfectly good for a Thai place.  Is it my favorite of all time, or the city? nope.  However this place serves up quality Thai food for a good price and so will probably receive a lot of my patronage over the next few years.

In terms of food, they have all the standards like Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, Drunken Noodles and Curries so you can find all your favorites here.  I ordered the Drunken Noodles, so I can only vouch for the quality of that so far!

McGrath's
For dinner tonight, I got a Dungeoness Crab Louie Salad with shrimp added on from McGrath's in Boise. You can't see it because it's hidden beneath the crab but this salad includes hard-boiled eggs, black olives, cucumbers and tomatoes. The Louie salad dressing came on the side. The salad came with fresh baked sourdough bread and butter. The salad was $22.99 before adding on the shrimp which was $1.99. The cook was confused by the ticket and gave me double the amount of shrimp for the same price. So I got 4 ounces of Dungeoness crab and 4 ounces of shrimp for that price. My lucky day! 

McGrath's is a small chain restaurant. Their first restaurant was in Salem, Oregon in 1980. They eventually expanded to 21 locations; today they have 5. They do dining and take out. If you like seafood, I would encourage you to give them a try. They do a great job!

Truly authentic Italian cuisine with a contemporary, creative spin. Beautifully prepared food with the freshest of ingredients! Couple amazing food with outstanding customer service and you have a gold standard experience!

Coffee is excellent, staff is super friendly and the new space rocks! I don't live in town anymore but I love when I get the chance to stop here for my coffee. Lots of options for a health conscious coffee lover. Way better than the typical chains.

Mashed potatoes were boxed, powdered, microwaved. Beef clung to the bone for dear life. Chicken didn't taste like it was really even meat. Corn has a strange pop to it that makes me glad my palette isn't defined enough to identify the cause of this unpleasant sensation. All priced above anything reasonable and served by a crew that clearly knew how unethical their actions were. Avoid at all costs.

This place has been on my brunch list for months. I finally found myself within a stone's throw and just had to give it a go. We were a party of two that had to wait 40 minutes because they only had tables of four ready. Yep, that happened. We watched multiple larger parties get seated before us, which is a bummer. 
Their breakfast booze were worth the wait, however the food fell a little short. One and done on this one, as it is now off the brunch list.

The food is good, but sad to say the experience was terrible, did takeout, placed the order online, an hour half later the food was not ready, the short hair lady was extremely rude!! i had to raise my voice as she was yelling, some customers even said she was rude to them. food- rice was overflavored,(smoked taste)  one of the orders had parts of spicy brown sauce, and my dish was bonesless sparerib(red)

This will be our last order from here!! clients  support the business i have no patience for patrons that do not understand how a business works.

Overall Yummy! 
We ate hot chicken sandwich and the hot chicken plate. Also you gotta try the poke nachos!!

Order was ready in a timely manner. The Pad Thai was delicious, hot, and was exactly the level of spicy that I requested. The shrimp eggplant was a little too oily for my liking. Overall good experience and will order again.
Nice clean place you literally can see a tv from every angle.  The staff is attentive fun loving.  Great food selection and very very clean.

Every order since the new ownership has been disappointing.  We've finally given up and stopped ordering from here.  It's obvious that were not the only ones, because I never see any other customers while picking up this year.  

Food ordered extra spicy is mostly sweet.  The hot and sour soup is neither hot nor sour.  

The location is close and easy for us.  So sad we have to take it off our list.

We stopped in for a quick bite after a fun morning at the theater. Service is spot on, we were seated promptly. Ordered 1/2 waffle, eggs scrambled with cheese, Fish tacos and chicken kale salad. Everything tasted delicious, the fish tacos are served in a lettuce leaf and just the right size for 1 person, the salad is a great size great flavor, a little bit spicy but the best tasting kale I've ever had. For desert we split the Sticky Toffee Pudding and . Best coffee I've had in a long time. Just simply yummy!

We went on a busy Saturday morning, wait was about 40 minutes which passed by pretty fast. Host and our waiter were both very pleasant. The kale tonic is soooo good, super refreshing I wish it came with refills lol. I got the breakfast tacos minus the chorizo with skillet potatoes instead of the black beans it usually comes with. The portions were just right my potatoes were a little saltier than I would have liked but no biggie. My bf got the trifecta with blueberry pancake and turkey sausage and eggs and a side of potatoes. The pancake was fluffy and just the right amount of sweetness. Everything else was cooked just right also. His potatoes tasted a lot better than the ones I got.

The last time I ate here was about 4 or 5 years ago. Ordering today, I remembered why. The food was ordered at 4:55pm through a food delivery app. It's currently 7:10pm and still no food. We live, at most, 15 minutes away! We called and were told the food would be delivered, "in 10 minutes," and that was 40 minutes ago. When we called, we were also informed they, "couldn't find the order,". If that's the food delivery app issue, so be it. However, don't then inform the patron the food will be delivered in 10 minutes. With the virus going around and self quarantine, we are trying to be respectful and understanding. A 2 hour wait for some mediocre pasta and a basic pizza pie is disappointing. If you are not hungry and don't mind the 2 hour wait, order here. Absolutely *will not* order from here again.

This evening was not Longhorns finest.  

Wait staff forgot my beverage. Loaded baked potato had one sliver of green onion and two bacon bits; a pat of butter and non-existent sour cream. 

The steak was not flavorful but drowned in oil with burnt edges(Longhorn Outlaw Ribeye - supposed to be medium rare). No one came buy to check in on how the steak was. 

Asked for tea again and waited several minutes to receive; understand I've been seated 15 minutes and already had my salad.   Asked for additional items for baked potato; was more than halfway through my steak before waitstaff brought them.

It's been a while since we have eaten at Louie's. We ordered food for delivery through Door Dash. We were very happy with the amount of food (leftovers!) and quality. We ordered the dinner for two combo, which included soup, pizza, fettuccine, rigatoni, and bread. You really can't beat the price for the amount of food plus the quality.

My husband and I were recommended to try this restaurant. I got the mild grilled chicken strips. Very good, I don't usually like spicy things but it was very good. My husband got the "get clucked" chicken. He has always done spicy  challenges at restaurants but this one really put him over the edge. He woke up puking. So I would say don't get the spiciest chicken lol. But all in all, 5 stars from me!

This is a good place for basic breakfast if you're in the area of 118th Avenue off 49th street, Clearwater, northeast from the US 19 exit. This is more of an industrial area of businesses and warehouses and I suspect its a go to place for its patrons. I saw all men, several sitting alone and all the rest groups of friends enjoying breakfast and cordial conversation. 

Servers are very friendly and welcoming. 

I enjoy home cooked from scratch meals and I think Gaby's made a credible breakfast. I noticed the lack of seasonings on eggs and home fries I ordered which in reality is healthier so the diner can add their own seasonings If they wish.

I also tried Gaby's homemade biscuits and gravy. Although I thought it lacked a sausage flavor it was ok. To be fare, I didn't try pancakes, waffles or other meats like bacon which looked inviting as I noticed on other plates.

Good tasting coffee. Very roomy interior. One can choose to eat from their bar or enjoy seating from plenty of tables.
All in all, I thought Gaby's was a long time established good basic eatery.

In a pre-COVID time, I used to work from Neidhammer on Friday afternoons to enjoy some coffee and pastries. It's a very cute cafe with lots of seating and plugs for your laptop. Unless there's a Friday afternoon wedding, when it can get a bit loud upstairs. Street parking on the nearby side streets (like N Hamilton Ave) is free and easy. I usually order their iced lavender vanilla latte with oat milk. I also like to try their seasonal drinks from time to time. You can also grab a few ciders from Ash & Elm (they share the building) to take home that night! Perfect pairing!

Stopped here after work today after hearing good things from a coworker. What a hidden gem this place is! Although their menu was not as extensive as many other Vietnamese restaurants I have been to, the food they have is amazing! I ordered the fried chicken Banh mi sandwich with the soy sauce (forget the name of it) and an order of the fries. Their fries are outstanding and the sandwich was fresh and delicious! Highly recommend for a lunch stop or an after work food run!

Libby's is a classic diner. Solid food and an inviting atmosphere.  

Came in with a large group for a pre football game breakfast. Was nervous at first because the place was completely empty but after 30 minutes or so, Libby's was packed. 

Excellent French toast.  Good eggs. Drip coffee was better than most and service was snappy and on point. 

Eat here. The food is good, especially the French toast and coffee!

I saw this pizza on someone's social media page and knew I had to try it! I'm not a big fan of pizza but it was something about the way the pizza looked! So I checked them out one evening with a Take Out! Let me tell you!! This is the BEST pizza I've ever tasted. The toppings were piled high, it was hot, juicy and delicious. The location is tucked away in Wanamaker. The staff is always happy to see you. I can't wait to actually sit down and eat at the restaurant. They even have a bar that is separate from the restaurant. If you like pizza...and even if you don't check them out!

The food was very good (4 stars) but this was hidden by the terrible service. (Knock off a star) I think it was our bad luck- or maybe the server didn't like us since we had children with us? Hopefully not that....everyone else seemed nice....
We ordered drinks, I knew what I wanted quickly, but the hubby is slow- well, he paid for that since our server disappeared for close to 20 minutes! She came back and we ordered my husbands drink- whew one task down! In fear that she would disappear again, we ordered our entire meal at that time. We had plenty of time to mull over the menu!! 

I asked her to assure everything g came out in order, cheese board first- then everything else. 

We got out delicious side of fries first......another 10 minutes passed.....then we received salad (basic caesar, good, nothing spectacular) poutine (this got votes for better than on a ski hill in Banff, Canada- wow! Needs more gravy tho), carne Asada tacos, kids Mac n cheese. No cheese board yet....asked for the drink menu, this time only 5 minutes passed! Then the cheese board came! Just pack it up. Sheesh. Asked for all the accoutrements in separate pack - nope- packed it my self, then up to the kitchen window myself to get the rest of the cheese and charcuterie board. Sheesh 

Drinks: old fashion ...ok; Cuban monitory twist- light and fresh, not too sour; the 3rd drink (forget the C name!) ape roll and peach bitters- it was good, but you must like the bitter taste of aperol. 

Tacos were packed f

Every time I go, I am impressed. From the service to the food, drinks, dessert. Excellent! Some servers are more knowledgable than others, but overall very pleasant. The food never disappoints, cooked exactly as asked. I will keep coming back!

Worst customer service ever. While there was a steady stream of customers, it was by no means overwhelming... yet EVERY employee I encountered was EXTREMELY rude. I ask the cashier to put a few more chips in my back and received a snarky response. This after the man in front of me had the exact same request, and was obliged. The store was also a mess. Don't recommend. Will not return.

I'm originally from Tucson but have lived in SF for the past 20 plus years. I came back to the original Cushing Street location to find it amazingly restored, complete with a beautifully lit Mexican tile courtyard (traditional blankets with the heat lamps, nice touch.) Do yourself a favor and peek in at the private rooms with the cozy benches and cholla cactus ceilings. The ambience was superb, I loved the attention to detail with the romantic lighting and the (Buffalo School?) seating. And the menu; Seriously, when they refer to Tucson as a UNESCO gastronomy site I think the Coronet would be top of mind. There were solid choices on the menu but they took chances as well. It was exciting to see the ancho bisque next to the grilled octopus with tiny heirloom tomato with chilies. I had a Brazilian seafood stew with anchovies from the Sea of Cortez. Amazing execution with a delicate touch. My dining companion had more traditional choices, but again, perfect execution on the meat with a deft hand on the accoutrements. And there was a tasteful jazz trio playing romantic standards in the corner, (How my Heart Sings!) What an amazing experience that rivals any in SF or Napa.

It's honestly a great spot. The food is really delicious and the experience is just amazing. You have a choice of eating at the bar or at the table where they cook in front of you. If you just go with a companion you will most likely share the experience with another party or parties. It's a great atmosphere, the amount of food for the price is reasonable, taste of the food is great, the service is great. They are just overall amazing. Take it from me I go there often and I mean like once a week often lol. (I don't give out 5 stars so easily lol sorry)
Extremely rude when I called them, telling me that it is too far to deliver to University City even though its like 14 mins drive.

Ordered Chicken Andouille Gumbo with Smothered Collard Greens and an Old Fashioned to drink(best I've had). Can't complain at all. It's crowded and stays busy so be prepared to wait a minute...definitely worth it.

Came in search of our go to Chinese food place. It was pretty quiet for a Sunday night. It was clean and service was pretty quick. We ordered shrimp and rice combo with egg drop soup and spring roll, steak and pad Thai noodles combo with egg roll and wonton soup and Korean BBQ combo with egg roll and wanton soup.
 
The shrimp and rice was  pretty good, not spectacular but not bad. Would have liked some yum yum sauce but did not see any. The spring roll was good and not greasy. The egg drop soup was also good. Our daughter liked the steak and pad Thai noodles, her favorite was the wonton soup. The egg roll were also very good and not greasy. The Korean BBQ was very spicy and not to our liking. We wished for more veggies. 

Dinner overall was good but would try a few different menu items next time but would stick with the soup and egg rolls. The price for three was about 50$ and we came home with leftovers. If we are in the area we would stop by again but not sure it is our go to place.

Had a minor hiccup here - which was that it took 15 min to get anyone's attention after being seated, but after that it was AMAZING from that point onward. I just moved from NYC and I couldn't imagine a better first meal in Indianapolis than Bluebeard. 

Wine pours are very generous here - which justifies the premium they charge by the glass vs the bottle (although tbh it's more so that the bottle pricing is just great value so I highly recommend that)

Charcuterie plate (3 for $17) was great - Mt Tam tastes like a really delicious Brie while the Alp Blossom was slightly cheddar-y and went super well with the apple jam. 

Wings ($18) were a little pricey but HUUUUGE and were super delicious but I recommend eating them fast or else they got soggy. Spoonfuls of trout roe were a nice touch. 

Octopus is a bit on the smaller side (as in the tentacles themselves, not the portion size which was perfect) but tasted delicious with the two sauces.

Highly recommend the beet salad ($9) which was more than enough to share between 2-3 people. Tangy, sweet, crunchy, creamy - this has it all.

Shrimp and Grits ($20) were delicious but also quite rich so you definitely want to share this, or just pass on it entirely in favor of the other things (a table had the spaghetti side and it looked amazing)

Big shout out to Kyle for being such an amazing server! Will definitely be back!
Great place to eat brunch! Mimosas are amazing as well as the food. Our waitress was very consistent. Highly recommend.

This is the slowest chic-fil- A on planet earth. Every time I go here I end up waiting for at least 30 minutes, whether it's drive thru or take out. Don't come here unless you plan on spending an hour at a "fast food" restaurant. 

Instead of working, many employees are often seen sitting down on their phones and pigging out on chicken nuggets. I don't understand it. Management needs to get it together.
Great atmosphere. Wait time 5-9 minutes (depending on party size). Food was excellent. Staff were friendly, patient and professional.

Good ramen . Good flavor, big portions. Delicious noodles . 

Clean place. 

Good service. Very polite and attentive.
#ljjiLove

Was looking for breakfast and this place was within walking distance of our resort.  I was surprise by the British take on breakfast but liked it. My French toast wad a little under done but the coffee was great.  It was okay.

Best Papa Murphy's location in the treasure valley. We had trouble ordering online a few times but Greg honored our online coupons twice. Super nice and accommodating. He puts customers first. Unlike the overland store where the girl was not helpful or nice and lacked basic customer service skills. This is our location of choice and happy it's close to our house. Thanks Greg!!! 5 stars.

Everything is on the pricier side, but you absolutely get what you pay for. I'd be happy to come back time and time again, but if I lived in the area I wouldn't be here terribly often. 

What a fun place to eat. Just as much thought was put into the interior as the food & wine. Speaking of wine, the wine choices are AMAZING. 

Anchovies were wonderful. Kale salad is a must. Arrabbiata pie was indeed very spicy (the sauce itself is spicy and the pie is loaded with peppers). Almost borderline too spicy, but not quite. It was excellent. 

Soft serve is diiiiiivine. (Especially after spicy pizza.) Even if you didn't save room for dessert, get it anyway.  

A large portion of the seating here is long-table family-style. 

Huge congrats to the pizzeria Beddia team for killing it in a larger space!!

Well, we have been eating at BJ's Barbeque since they were located in the Silver State shopping center next to Long's drug... This year has been a challenge but we have managed to dine-in 3 or 4 times. This last visit was awesome as usual. The food is the best in the West and the service is always good whether they are packed or at 25% capacity. The kick-ass fries have always been a hit with my family and they have expanded the offering to include several options. I had the bad-ass version with brisket, it was absolutely amazing. My daughter had the pork ribs, again, the meat falls off the bone and satisfies even the heartiest of appetites. What a wonderful Sparks fixture in food land. Highly recommend.
Got takeout and the food was delicious as always.  The menu has changed since the last time I was here. Got the big bad wolf sandwich which was excellent.

I had a pretty bad experience, ordering was confusing. We thought the girl had our order correct because we were explaining it to her more than twice. When we had our order repeated to us it seemed right. We then proceeded to the window, there was a car waiting in front of us for what seemed to be more than 10 minutes. Instead of telling the person to pull up because there was a girl out giving customers their food. She then started giving us our drinks which were exactly opposite from what we have ordered. The bag of food was small but it seemed odd that she didn't tell us anything else. She was giving other customers their food behind us. So after the car passed through we did as well. Thinking we got our food but then we turned around and waited another 30 minutes and still after trying to order our food again. They still got it all wrong, by the time we got to my sister's house. The food was cold. They had all sorts of errors in itself. And it's so funny because the night before we got dinner and it was so great. Too bad it's not consistent.

Oaken Barrel is one of those hidden gems that many from the south side don't know about. I'm a big fan of the cowboy caviar and the homemade chips with bacon dip. You absolutely can't go wrong with these appetizers.  Razz Wheat (pre gluten allergy) was one of my favorite drink options!

There is a large menu with something for everyone's taste buds. I wish they had a few more gluten free offerings, but I just make sure I'm in the mood for a burger when we plan for Oaken Barrel. I do also wish there were some better offerings drink wise for those who can't have gluten, but I realize they are a brewery and sometimes that's not a priority. Service is always great no matter how busy and many of the servers have been there for years. It's nice to see the familiar faces.

It's still a longtime favorite and a must try!  They get extremely busy on the weekends so plan accordingly.

I wasn't looking forward to coming because I'm not a fan of cake, but man was this one good. It's on the pricey side but the portions are very large. We loved the tea and there is so much to love about the atmosphere. Sometimes when go somewhere fancy the feel of the place doesn't match, but Cake Bake doesn't disappoint.
Food was good. Beer list was big but nothing exceptional and very IPA heavy. Feral children abound.
Great pizza. Good flavor and loved the crust. Would definitely order again! I also got the garden salad, which was a nice addition.

Great spot for Vietnamese FOOD!!!Delicious rice platters ! Love the custom dessert options. Service 5 stars -highly recommend for date night . Food temp always perfect. For me -  enjoyed ALL the  rice platters & pork chops. Didn't like the BBH - pho was just ok . Service solid perfect every time. Servers are very attentive. Cleanliness full 5 stars. My 4 stars rating is base on overall experience and taste of food.

One of my favorite spots! Ali is the owner, so Ali makes the tastiest food in Reno, as does his brother who owns another Mediterranean restaurant. These guys know their stuff. I always get the beef shawarma platter. The yogurt and the hummus that accompanies the savory, tender shawarma with some chili sauce.... to die for. Thanks Ali for existing and making my life better.

Best Sushi in the city!

Amazing service. Just insanely fast getting your food out. The fish always tastes fresh.

Great pho joint, large menu, go to spot.
Been coming back to this place whenever I go out for pho, broth consistency hasn't been an issue anymore as before the quality was hit or miss with the broth being overly salty or off tasting. I prefer co do hue over Pho Hoan Pasteur which is now a distant 2nd imo.
Really cool atmosphere, great vegan friendly food! I got to eat a breakfast burrito that was delicious and such a treat.

Love this place! We stopped off here on our way to TX- if you like a place that offers HEALTHY options but ALSO has bar food this is ur spot. We are traveling with a group of people who all have diff tastes, I personally wanted a good salad and that's exactly what I got- the paleo salad is amazing! I got it with grilled shrimp but it typically comes with grilled chicken. Others in the group are typical meat and potato/American food types so they were happy as well. It's Reasonably priced and a cool atmosphere - it's like a bar/diner with quality food. The servers were friendly as well. Def recommend!

I don't know if it's just this location but the workers here do have brains!! They think so clearly and at a fast paced rate. They always welcome you, they are ok with every request you make, they even offer you condiments for free. I would say that this is one of the cleanest places I have been to. The workers always change their gloves, they clean off the tables and maintain an overall clean environment. I think it's safe to say that I am a fan and I love MOD!!
Lovely ambience but most of the food is average except the fried green tomatoes. Also, it's a cash only place so be prepared. Be prepared for really long wait times on the weekends too.

Must say that P'unk Burger is such a nice place. The staff is pleasant and the place itself is adorable. The menu is really amazing, lots of great choices, I had to go with Big Man on Campus Burger, and it was amazing. The team was very friendly and service is exceptional. Thanks to yelp for recommending P'unk Burger.

I would like to rate this place a 5 star because their service and food is VERY good quality. I am a host/ server at Azian Korean bbq and had a bad day and decided to quit due to poor management, and a hostile environment. I came into miss Saigon and received a very touching message from my waiter, " I hope you are doing okay and just to let you know, you got this!". It really touched my heart to see such happy and caring people. I 100% RECCOMEND MISS SAIGON!!!!!

The chicken here is awesome. Love getting the 1/2 chicken plate making my own burrito w rice, beans, and all the awesome homemade salsas they have. That dish will last about 2.5 meals. Highly recommend.
The ambience of the place is very inviting. Service is good . We had the lunch buffet , which had wide range of selection but the overall taste of the food is average.

This is the best AYCE hotpot in Edmonton. First of all, the decor is quite modern/nice. There is also adequate spacing between tables (whereas some other places can make you feel like you're in a hotpot sauna). In terms of service, the servers are mostly attentive and knows more English. In terms of the setup, most of the food RE open for anyone to grab - which is quite nice as I don't have to wait for the server to get me my 2 quail eggs. They also have a large selection of food. Note the taro tapioca dessert is definitely worth getting. Finally, they also have fairly fresh/decent quality meat (so much so that I don't recall another place having better or more consistent quality of lamb than them).
Love king of the coop love they're chicken love they're fries and love they're bread and butter pickles and to make things better the customer service exceeds the food keel it up guys

I have been a hand full of time and I will tell you this place is very delicious. I am very stern on if I think a restaurant is good or not and I have to to say that this place it fire  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Service was amazing but the wings were smaller than my thumb and pink inside. My stomach is KILLING me. The sauce was good but the wings themselves were terrible. 20 dollars for wings that have 2 bites of meat on them... 1 dollar for a side of ranch.. at a WING place ?? Are you kidding? Will not be returning here.

Amazing establishment, I'm so happy that they've reopened post covid. The Bife Ancho is hands down the best steak in NOLA. The Gaucho Plate is perfect to share and a great value for It's size. The Sweetbreads are what my dreams are made of as are the delicious Empanadas. Service is always impeccable. My wife and I have eaten here many times and it never fails to impress me. Pay no attention to the lame, bad reviews that give zero information on the establishment. Makes me think they are robo accounts. Do yourself a favor and dine here if the opportunity arises, You will not regret it.

Such a great spot for breakfast! The skillet hashes are filling and hit the spot in terms of taste. There are a few options, I got the Market Skillet Hash and the mushrooms, spinach, eggs and goat cheese all pairs deliciously well. I will say, with the potatoes, the dish sometimes becomes way too heavy of a meal. The Morning Mediation juice is amazing! I highly recommend you try it. It is a great way to start the day and an amazing breakfast. Coffee also taste good and service is on point and friendly.

I usually don't t bother to write negative reviews. I mean, people can lose their jobs just because you are in a bad mood or they are having an offf night. But we've eaten there several times with similar experiences, so I guess it's finally to finally say something. 

Last time we went to McGraths, the service was so terrible that we finally walked out after 15 minutes  with no drinks delivered. The tables surrounding us were  all demanding to see the manager

This time, drawn back by the AYCA fisherman's platter special, we encountered another round of subpar service, leading us  to guess that the training is either awful or the servers are cooking all the orders. Judging from food quality, it must be the latter.  Once again, many patrons were demanding the manager, and we heard many servers apologizing over and over.

I know you can only expect so much for $17 a plate, but too much batter, frozen pasta, frozen clams, wilted fries, gummy clam chowder.  Just. Not. Good. If the service was great, this would be a great place to  get drunk and eat greasy food.  But with the slowwwwww service, it's pretty much impossible to get intoxicated enough to make the experience enjoyable.

Ordered food from this place last night through Door Dash and oh my gosh it was SO GOOD. It was made and delivered so quick, it was awesome. The packaging was also very nice so nothing spilled in the bag. Although, they didn't provide silverware and napkins so thank goodness it was just delivered to our house. The vermicelli was very tasty and the sauce that they give you wasn't too fishy as other Vietnamese places have. Their potstickers though....oh.my.gosh. Some of the best potstickers I've ever had and the sauce they give you to dip them in was so addicting! Only complaint I have is the wrapping/shell of the potstickers was much too thick which didn't leave much room for filling but still good!

Had the Chx teriyaki dinner plate, California roll, dragon roll, caterpillar roll and the cotton candy roll. The last three rolls were good but the chx teriyaki was terrible. I didn't know you can mess up on a chx teriyaki but this place manage to do just that. The chicken was rubbery and flavorless. The teriyaki sauce was also not very good, inedible. The California roll was stale, like they've had it sitting in the back for a while waiting for someone to order it. A couple of bright spots though. The staff was very friendly. And the other specialty rolls were actually pretty tasty. In conclusion never ever get the chicken teriyaki or the California rolls! But come for the staff and the specialty rolls.

Great lunch spot for a slice, coke and fries.  I have been known to go here a couple of days a month for a slice.  Service is always great and they make sure everything is OK a few times while you're there (even when you just get a slice).  Great job, guys.  Keep it up!

My favorite place to go in SB  food is unreal, I always get the combo and the Shawarma plate and then share. It's a ton of delicious food with so many fun dips and sauces. Also, the outdoor seating is so beautiful.

Definitely recommend coming here for a filling, scrumptious meal.

Our host the first time was the sweetest, most bubbly girl. Forgot her name but she was so cheerful and helpful and made our experience perfect!

Every time I come to town I go to pinnacle peak. This time we had a pretty bad experience. We understand that with the recent Covid 19 pandemic that things will look different and there will be rules in place that aren't normally there. However, we were not told upon making our reservation that we would be eating on paper boxes with tinfoil on them with plastic silverware. It was very difficult to cut the steak and to keep the tinfoil from being eaten. Also, we had multiple items missing from our original order such as salad dressings and drinks that we eventually received but was too late. The table we sat at was leaning way over at an angle and the tablecloth smelled musty. I am sad to say that we spent over 200 dollars for this experience. The steaks were not up to par either. Sadly I don't know if I will go back again.
Great food and even greater customer service. A good amount of vegan and vegetarian options. Go here!!

So here's the deal. Shanghai is closed on Tuesdays so this place came up. I hadn't been here in over 6 years and that's my mistake.
The takeout and order process was good over the phone. Lunch specials were in effect and it was pretty cheap. They even managed to give us soup! 
The food was hot, tasty and we got four meals out of the deal!

I am unhappy to write this review, as I typically LOVE Haru, but my recent visit on Saturday June 20th, 2020 was a piss poor one.  As a person who also works at a local place here in Reno, I wanted to come support one of my favorite local joints. I have waited so long thru COVID-19 to come grab some delicious tonkatsu ramen and chicken kara-age. I had called ahead of time to see if they were open and a female answered and told me "Yes, we are open until 9pm tonight." I happily and excitedly told her I would be heading over now! and she answered with "okay see you soon!"  To my dismay, when I arrived I was greeted by the head chef and he had asked me if I had made a reservation. I told him no, that I had just called and the woman did not say anything about making a reservation. The woman who had answered the phone FAILED to tell me that I NEEDED a reservation. This is not a review about the food quality, but more on the crap service I received prior to even getting to eat here again. Even though I didn't get to eat, Haru that night left a sour taste in my mouth. 


Will not be coming back for a while, seeing as Haru only has approximately 5 tables available at a time.

Eaten here twice now. Lunch and dinner. Food is terrible. My steak was swimming in a thick sauce, that I had to scrape it off.  Potatoes were terrible each time. I was excited about the salad bar, but the selection was odd and unappealing and didn't taste fresh.  Last time we were there, we were adjusting our masks (we had them on our face) and the hostess snapped at us; "wear your mask - NOT my RULE!"  which was offensive to use, because we did have them on.  I told her not to take a tone and she swung around and in the most condescending way said: "I didn't take a tone ma'am!"   Bad food, rude hostess. Pass on Sperry's.

Eh. It's fast food. Burgers are thin and fried in so much grease it leaves a weird ring of crusty gook. Fries are thin and tasteless. The shakes are good but sort of ordinary. They do have a lot of options so maybe I'll give it another try for the custard.

The main reason I love this place is the total focus on Jesus. From the Christian music they play to the prayer closet and the prayer wall it's just different. The food is amazing as well with great options for all diets. I had a vegan burrito and it was tasty and filling! I was pleasantly surprised that the coffee was to my liking as well.

I LOVE the CBH Ellerslie location! My husband & I, come every Friday night, for "date night". We've gotten to know all the servers & the entire staff, has become like a 2nd family. 

Gord & his staff, are simply amazing! The customer service is always outstanding. I see the other servers, helping each other out all the time. Pat is super friendly & personable. I can really tell the management team, runs things super smooth. The servers respect each other and management too. 

The food is great, we've never had a bad meal! A few weeks ago, my husband had the 30oz Tomahawk Steak & it tasted better than a steak, at The Keg. 

Love the new menu! So many great choices, hard to pick a fav! But you have to try the Peanut Butter Pie!

Ate here while visiting last month.  Had a large family dinner in a busy Friday night.  As a suggestion from my cousin, I had the shrimp tacos...  They were the BEST I have ever had and I frequent the Texas coast often.  Will definitely be visiting again.  Thanks for a great meal.

We've eaten here several times but have always say at the bar. Tonight we had our kids so the bar wasn't an option. 
To say we had THE worst service is an understatement. It was busy but there were several empty tables and we were seated quickly. 
We waited over 10 minutes for our 4 sodas. When our server finally came back to place our order, we kept it pretty simple, an appetizer, 2 wraps and 2 salads. 
After about 10 minutes, our server returned and he asked what kind of wrap our daughter ordered. 
He returned several times to tell us "just a few more minutes". 
We noticed our tables who were seated after us, receive their orders and we still hadn't received our appetizer. After over 90 minutes and more "just a few more minutes", I went to the server and asked how much longer. He said he knew and it was busy. I told him I understand but there were people seated after us, who received their orders, ate and paid and we haven't even received our appetizer. He put his hand on his forehead and told me he forgot to put our appetizer in. I asked for our bill for the sodas at that point and went back to our table. 
We left. And yes, he charged us $12 plus tax for our 4 sodas!

Ayeeee good food. Pad Thai was on point. 4 stars for the big buff Thai guy waiter cuz I respect a man that probably squats 3 plates each side. Service was slow but there was a lot of people so it's chill.
Nice ambiance and great service. Wide selection of salads, meats and sides. Would definitely try again.

I was going to give this place a bad review bc my husband were mislead by the hostess to think we were going to wait 3 mins for a table and ended up waiting over an hour! HOWEVER, it was a Saturday at dinner time and after we tried the food and experienced the service I completely changed my mind. This place is great! Coming from a Mexican woman who knows what real authentic and tasty Mexican food SHOULD taste like this place is just great (except for their red salsa, that needs work). I had the mole negro and my husband had the cazuela pibil, both excellent.

What a cool place! Instantly felt classier after waking in. Came in for weekend brunch after making a reservation online one hour in advance. Beats waiting in line like the green eggs gang across the street... The service was great and the food was even better!

I was torn between getting the fried chicken (which I've heard so much about) versus trying something else. Ultimately, I made a game decision to order the lemon ricotta pancakes (cause sitting in a fancy place deserves a fancy sounding dish, right?). Goodness gracious was I happy about that decision! The pancakes was light inside and had  surprisingly (and delicious) crunchy edges. Loved the edges so much that I worked my way around the pancakes before working on center.  The pancakes were topped with a ricotta cream infused with lemon and mint, which created a light and fresh taste. Adding the tartness from the nice and plump blueberries, I was getting the perfect bite! The portion was also very generous. I was not able to finish the whole thing. My only regret was ordering the side of turkey bacon (I was a fool for substituting real bacon). It was a nice savory compliment to the pancakes, but it didn't have the crispness I expect from bacon.

Overall, I would give it 4.5 stars. The price, for me,  is pretty reasonable to slightly more on the pricier side. Although, I was pretty satisfied with what I paid for. I would definitely come back for brunch and would definitely order the pancakes again. Although, their othe

While visiting Philly a friend recommended we try this place out. Unfortunately due to Covid restrictions we could not dine in unless we wanted to wait 30+ minutes so we decided to just get togo. The staff was super friendly and accommodating and we got our order in about 15 minutes. We got the chicken tacos, 2 orders of the corn (so delicious!!), a burrito, churros and I personally got the salad with shrimp added. All the food was super flavorful and we devoured it. Best part to top off the meal was the blackberry margarita I was also able to get Togo. I hope to come back again next trip to Philly and hopefully can dine in.

We had an excellent meal and fantastic service. I was there with a business colleague. We shared a number of appetizers and had a couple of drinks each. The ahi and avocado ceviche was especially memorable, as were the shrimp mini chimis. The food was delicious but still light -- we left feeling satisfied and healthy, and the bill was actually more reasonable than I expected for the quality of the experience. I can't wait to go back!

Bonefish Grills are normally dependable decent meal. My experience here was questionable. 

30 min wait, fine. The host takes my cell phone number. 45 minutes later, no text. I walk in and no one is in the waiting area. The lady tells me my name was "deleted"... then "auto-deleted".. then I asked to wait again because the right-sized table was not available. 

Bang-Bang shrimp = normal, decent. 

Bread and oil (which came after the appetizer) = same. 

Gnocchi dish = fail. The dish wasn't balanced at all and  the lobster was a step up from rubber food. I tasted and felt like it was sitting outside in the elements for hours. Painful. The plate looked good and then it completely fell apart. Unfortunate.

Perfect!  Finally, a chill yet vibrant place in Nashville!  Slightly, ever so slightly off the beaten path and yet all of what I wanted from this iconic city: food (get the mac-n-cheese), good strong drinks, great live music, multi pool lessons levels, friendly staff, most amazing people watching,  etc. Angela at the upstairs bar made me feel right at home, so friendly, super beautiful,  great drinks, fantastic smile. Sebastian at the door was awesome, friendly and inviting as was the reason we meandered inside. Views?! Stop it, ridiculous.

Bun bo hue is my go to whenever I crave Vietnamese food, and Noodle City is the only one in the area that has it.
The broth is delicious, always pair it with extra chili oil and meat balls. (I always order super)

The only reason this is a 4-star is because rarely, the soup tastes a bit off, other than that, it's tasty!

Oh wow. What an underrated gem. People are absolutely sleeping on this place.  Ok let's start: maybe THE best tortas in town. Very good carne asada. Excellent veggie burrito. Sometimes I'll just buy like 3 bean burritos and go home and shove them in my face. You can tell they're using good ingredients for sure. I haven't tried the menudo yet but EVERYTIME I come in on the weekends there's always like 12 dudes eating this stuff, so obviously I need to try it ASAP. Staff is friendly too.

Do not shop at this establishment even during the Covid crisis. I tried to support them by ordering takeout and they were extremely rude. They didn't even thank me for my order when I went to pick it up. Skip them use the Avon location.

SOUR Alfredo gives you a vomit after taste in your mouth. My husband agreed and said the same thing. In one of the other reviews someone said the chicken was sour. Everything else I've tried the soup, ravioli, and pizza is okay. Idk if I'd trust this place.

This is a really fun place to go.  It is also an excellent place to bring visitors if you live in the area.  I have been here serval times, so this is an over all review not a one time experience review.  Tiki Beach is so much fun and I will be back.  In the day time for lunch during the week it is very slow and quiet.  The daytime views are amazing.  Just spectacular and you are sitting a stones throw from the water.  The daytime wait staff was not so great and that is why I have to give only 3 stars.  They are not to friendly and seem bummed that they are at work.  The day time lunch staff gave us an Un-itemized bill.  Just the final price at the bottom.  We thought that was strange and the waitress rolled her eyes and said we do it all the time.  Ok, well it comes off dishonest -even if it is not.  Sorry it just does.  When we sat down for lunch the waitress would not even bring us a drink unless we started a TAB.. -- I get it at night when its clearly a hopping bar.  BUT we were literally the only table there for lunch.  A tab for a drink at lunch in the dining area? ODD again.  So good things are: The valet parking, yes you hav to pay....but it is not expensive. Something like 4 dollars an hour.  Not bad.  AND if yo come at night you have to pay a 10dollar cover and get a wrist band to enter the area, no matter which part you go to.  Just pay and go in and have a good time.  The food is good.  The service is attentive.  Now if it is a Saturday night and a band is playing

Truly amazing!! Everything from appetizers to entree. We had the risotto ball and yes I forgot the the Italian name for them. Then the arugula salad which was very fresh but a tad bit to much acidity with the lime. It was if they used lime concentrate. It was still great and would order it again then the true show stopper, gnocchi!!! Literally little pillows for your mouth and are to die for. I got it with the blush sauce and omg I am still craving it. Lastly I got the chicken piccata and it was light with the lemon sauce but semi creamy. Everything was truly amazing and was amazing!!

Been in this nice little restaurant bar quite a few times! I've always had great service by my server or bartender. Food is great and normally fast, all depending on business, but they do a fine job of getting me my food in a timely manner! Without a doubt, the best part of my meals here are when one of the managers, Ashley, always comes by and asks me how my food and service was! However, when I came in the last time, Ashley was my server! Best service I've ever gotten, but sadly, no manager came by to ask me about my food. The other female manager seems to always be wandering around, and by the end of the night I always see her drinking! I understand, restaurant business is tough, but you should never let your paying customers see that! So very unprofessional! I recommend this place to everyone, but this is a huge disappointment for me. Let's just hope Ashley is working the next time you come in.

So I've eaten a lot of sushi, and have a lot to compare to. Food wise, I loved the specialty roll options they had, the mango roll was especially good, and the soft shell crab appetizer was amazing! They didn't have a ton of simple raw rolls that I like (tuna and avocado, salmon mango, shrimp mango, etc), but that's fine! Most importantly, the service was amazing!! Our waitress was so nice, and it made our night! Will definitely go back again :)

We were told this was a good place to try while in town and it didn't disappoint.   I got chicken tikka masala and it was very yummy.  The chicken was grilled before entering the sauce and the sauce was different than other tikka masala I've had (not quite as sweet) but super tasty with just the right amount of heat.  The naan is huge and tasty. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is the salad I got really didn't have much flavor.  We'll definitely keep this on our list to come back.

Very clean, great parking and extremely easy to get to off the highway since we are not from here. This is the first time we have ever been to a wild eggs.  Unique breakfast menu which is a plus. Known for a hashbrown casserole which I will admit was amazing. Also table side baked cinnamon roll was great and I am not someone that even likes baked goods.

Fast and friendly service. The price range is very reasonable: $8.99-9.99 for a large and tasty burger with spot-on, perfectly seasoned fries can't be beat in the area. 

I ordered the Farmhand burger. Perfectly cooked, large beef patty, delicious cheese, topped with fresh onions, crisp pickles, French fried onions and a delicious bbq sauce. Now, one of my favorites. 

Another person ordered the Tennessee burger. He's honestly not a big fan of burgers. But he loved it and ate every bite. 

The other two ordered the PDK burger and especially loved the Dijon aioli with it along with the great fresh toppings. 

A great place to stop if you're in the area!

Ambiance was great!  We had a high top right before the open part of the restaurant.  On the weekends you may want to get in line before they open to ensure you get the best spots.  In the summer it's going to get really hot up there.

The service was really good too!  They went over the top when we dropped one of our Tostones bringing us whole new plate instead of just bringing us the one we dropped which would have been just fine.  More importantly she was friendly and our drinks were always full!

As for the food it wasn't very good.

We ordered the Vaca Frita Tostones and the Jerk Chicken Eggs Rolls.  If I had to pick one if would be the Eggs Rolls. The taste was there if you like jerk, but the chicken was very dry so they were hard to enjoy.  The Pineapple dipping was good.  When it comes to the Tostones the short rib was very fatty not much to enjoy if you're eating all fat.  I definitely won't get those again. 

We will definitely be back for cocktails!!

We did a take and bake order for the lasagna for two plus a cinnamon roll. We picked the dinner up at 1pm. The lasagna was frozen and the Cesar salad was cold. The dinner came with salad croutons heirloom tomatoes, bread, vegetables,cookies and turkey lasagna. Everything was very good. The vegetables had purple and orange carrots. There was enough food for two people with medium appetites for two meals!  It was a bargain. I encourage people to try the take and bake. The cinnamon roll was fabulous as usual. We will be back!

Where to begin first of all I realize with the Blues winning there was a lot of business downtown and they were extremely busy. My daughter lost her cell phone I tried everything to get ahold of this business you can't speak to a person you must send an email which seems crazy to me. My daughter emailed them on Wednesday finally Sunday someone returned her call. We made two trips downtown one time in which the bartender laughed and said they were way too busy to check 3 pm on Friday. Finally on Tuesday I personally made a trip down there the young lady at the door smirked at me and said the phone wasn't there. We have find your iPhone on the device as well. Needless to say we bought a new phone my daughter isn't allowed near this establishment. Management should have called me back.

I have been searching for an excellent pizza in my area for years.  Mazella's is amazing but they don't deliver. On a whim I tried Sciarrinos tonight and it was divine.  You can't go wrong with this pizza.

We loved this restaurant so much we came twice in three days.  The outdoor setup is charming, and the food was unforgettable (big plug for the octopus, scallops, shrimp and duck!).  The service was also terrific - our server Catherine was great!  We're already making plans to come back in the fall on our next trip to Lambertville.

Called in for take out on a weekend and said the wait was around 20 minutes which was not bad at all. When I got there, I rang the doorbell but no one answered - probably have to call them once you are there.

- Sauteed Vermicelli with Sauteed Pork - This is a pretty traditional Szechuanese dish so I was pretty surprised when they sold it here and I would say that its one of the best things on the menu. 
- Tomato with Egg - They give a disproportionate amount of rice for the the dish itself which doesn't have that much flavor. Also the egg is a little slimy, would not recommend.

Overall, solid Chinese restaurant on the Loop, would definitely come here to try the other options.

The food is delicious. It's best for carry out because their dining room is small.
It's an order-at-the-counter place (no servers).

Normally FK is one of my favorite restaurants, but tonight was a different story unfortunately. I was looking forward to coming back for the first time since COVID and wasn't able to get what I was looking for. I typically only order steak because I'm
very sensitive to things that are too spicy, even when someone else wouldn't typically think it's spicy. When I arrived, I noticed there was a limited protein selection on the menu, but grilled steak was there, so I decided to stay. By time my 6 bowl was built and I got to protein, I was informed they ran out of steak. I really wish they would have covered this option on the menu like the other unavailable meats, as I likely would have left and came back a different day, but at this point I felt guilty to waste a bowl that was mostly built. So I asked for a sample of the chicken to ensure it'd be okay, and not too spicy. I was then informed that they were not doing samples. I really am all for all the extra precautions for the virus, but please explain to me how putting a piece of chicken into a cup and handing it to a customer the same way you'd hand them the completed bowl is any different or risks contamination? It's silly in my opinion. Anyways, it wasn't busy so I chatted with the employee about my sensitivity and she assured me the chicken wasn't spicy at all. So I went ahead and paid for my $15 bowl. Now I'm home, an hour later and sat down for dinner. Two bites in and I can't eat any of the meat because the sauce is inde

If you are expecting a regular brewery this isn't it. It is a small market type place with no heat and a few stools at a counter for the bar. They only had 4 beers on tap and as far as the pizza, I've seen a bigger kitchen in a food truck. Super depressing in here. We were excited about this but left before ordering.
The best breakfast and dare I say meal in NOLA! We come here every morning we are in town... Just get the Benedict special and you will never go wrong!!!

I have been here numerous times because how close it is to work and usually get  the lunch special.  Overall this place is average. I do not see the big hype especially due to the Food Network coming here. The lunch special price was great. Once I had catfish could be seasoned more. Youcan't go wrong with the salads here. Again cool lunch spot for those working in the area.

So my update isn't about the egg breakfast, but about the bagel that I finally got to try (and mentioned in the last review).  I got a cinnamon raisin bagel with plain cream cheese, and I have to tell you, it reminded me so much of the bagels I used to get in New York.  I've never found ones like that here.  It wasn't overly chewy on the outside and had a different outer texture than the usual ones I have at other places, and there was a perfect amount of cream cheese.  I moved out of this neighborhood and still think about that bagel, so, you should probably try one too.

This was the only restaurant open on a Sunday night at 7:30 P.M. in Downtown Tucson. Our server was amazing as was the food. Delicious starters that included Edamame and Dumplings. The ramen was outstanding, flavorful.  Also ordered a Chinese fried chicken salad, and both were tasty. The only issue we had was with the hostess. When we walked in she stated it would be a minimum 45 minute wait. Since nothing else was open we decided to sit it out and wait. I still am
not clear on their reservation policy but some guests walked in and were immediately seated while others like my husband and I were waiting for tables to clear. Even after guests left the hostess would take 25 minutes to wipe down a table.  We did confirm though that they do not take reservations. It was a weird dining experience but once we sat down as new customers were coming in she wasted no time in seating them at tables that had been opened fir 45 minutes.  I felt a little bit ostracized and we never even told her we were conservatives. I am curious if she just sensed it!

Ran by here's on a Friday night to grab pizza to go.  Ordered a large cheese and garlic knots by phone about 10 minutes before I got there.  They said it would be ready in 15 minutes.  Parking is a little difficult - you're right on Main Street and there's not really any official parking.  I stopped somewhere that wasn't really a spot and just jumped out quick.  Pizza was ready even though I was early.  Very reasonably priced - $12 for the pizza and knots.  Both were hot and tasty.

Honestly beautiful place but wasn't too pleased with our server!! Too much attitude/rudeness and not accommodating at all from the start! I kindly ask her to fix something that I did not like with my food! She just complained for a good 5 min and tried to argue with me!!! Without even notifying us and asking us that the kitchen closes at 2:30...when I tried to place an order for something else she's like the kitchens closed!!! Uh don't they usually come up to you and say it's last call just really really bad customer service!!

We went at 10 which starts the 2 for 1 beers. They bring them both out at the same time which was surprising but awesome. Also got the medium Cajun pepperoni pizza which was on special. Very delicious but maybe the beer helped!

Would go back, great atmosphere and the food was great
Just got a pizza today July 2 order any for six got here at 10 after seven stone cold it would love a fucking call pizza thanks grubHub, i'll never order another pizza Anthony's coal fired pizza!
The food taste great! I got the turkey pesto wrap and love it. The chips are good as well. The only thing is the seats aren't to great. Kinda torn and wore down but manageable

Great Wings!    I was down there on vacation and stopped in.

Walking in the place can be a little intimidating but no fear.   It is a bristling business with carryout only.    People coming and going to get their favorite wings.   

The wings are meaty and the sauce is very good.

When I return, I am sure I will pop in to pick up some wings.

Being a huge Korean fried chicken fan, I wanted to try out a smaller place that wasn't Bonchon. I had heard some friends hype yo this place, so I wanted to give it a try myself. I came in with a few friends around 8PM on a weekday. I loved the ordering screens that were in the restaurant; they gave me time to look through the menu and choose sauce options.

After perusing the menu and sides for quite some time, I went with a 10-piece Wings and Sweet Potato Fries side. I ended up choosing the Honey Soy and Sweet Chili Spicy Sauce options for my chicken.

In about 10 minutes, my name and order number were called at the counter, and I picked up my food. I was impressed by the size of the wings, and they appeared to look super saucy and appetizing. After taking my first bite, I was impressed. The crunch was great, and I really enjoyed both sauce flavors. Neither was overwhelmingly sweet or spicy. My Sweet Potato Fried, however, were a bit disappointing. They lacked any type of salt and tasted a bit flavorless. The crunch and texture were great, but just adding a touch of salt upon cooking could have fixed them. 

Overall, I liked this place a lot. I definitely wouldn't consider it a replacement for Bonchon, but it's a cool restaurant to visit regardless. I like the wing quality, sauce variety, and would I definitely be very curious to try other menu items in the future.

Very efficient at this location!! Inside closed due to Covid mess! But they have employees taking your order outside as you wait in the drive thru line! Employees friendly, quick process even though there was a long line! They hand you food sealed in a bag sitting in a plastic tub. Employees wearing masks, gloves!! Completely organized they are!! Other food places need to take lessons from here on how its done!! Food yummy as always!!! Excellent job!
Love their sweets! Got my sons cake and smash cake was free with the size we ordered back in November. They did an amazing job on it!! So hard to go in and not order one of everything!!

Absolutely wonderful- such a nice surprise with live guitar, kindly took my order, local art on the walls, and surprisingly good pastries- I haven't had breakfast pastries that delightful since visiting Janjou!

The quality of their chicken is always on point! A little pricey if you're getting anything outside of a combo for yourself but it's definitely tasty. I wouldn't recommend anyone with high blood pressure to eat here if you haven't taken your blood pressure meds. Other than that they are absolutely delicious!

Overall a great experience! They modified my meal to accommodate my needs which is awesome! Be warned, go early otherwise you will be waiting. As for service, the first time we went, the gentleman said my chosen meal did not include a muffin but on the second trip the other server said it does...overall, a small oversight just wish he would have offered to check or verify but can't win them all. Also, if you have kids they have a cute coloring page and the servers were engaging and perfect with my hungry babies!!

We celebrated our anniversary here and Chef Connor was a great teacher. The class was extremely informative, fun, and the food was absolutely delicious. It was just me and my boyfriend and we took the New Orleans Sauce Class

After several months of working in the area I decided to stop into first watch. I'm more of a quick breakfast type of girl so I usually head over to the Starbucks next door but this morning I wanted something a little more special. I ordered a BLTE (BLT + Egg) which was actually bigger than I expected, but for $10, it better had been that big. I really wish they toasted the bread on it though (but that's personal preference). It came with a nice small side Salad which Im saving for lunch. Overall the experience was good, the ingredients in the food tasted fresh & I was in and out the restaurant for takeout. I probably wouldn't do takeout here again but I would come to dine in.

This place has a great view of downtown and lots of outdoor seating, which provided a lovely environment for a quick breakfast. The sausage egg and cheese croissant was perfectly fine if not a little normcore, and the latte was excellent. I wasn't as much a fan of my partner's breakfast burrito, although the smokiness of the roasted tomatoes in the salsa was interesting. But the place was near our hotel and the service was great, and those points alone are worth checking out if you're in the area and want something fast and simple.
Food was super hot in temp and fast service. The fried okra was the best I have ever eaten. Chicken sandwich was delicious.
Great sandwiches. The crew at this location is not cut-in.  Hopefully that will get sorted out.

Food is great, when you can get it. Last 3 times l've gone they've run out of Broccoli n cheddar soup, make more!! It's my lunch hour at noon, like sooo many other people,if they don't close till 9pm then you can make more! You're losing out on money!
Love Da Bomb salad! And they have some outdoor seating. Feels very safe. And genuinely nice people.

This review calls for negative stars.  First off, extremely rude and nasty male host. No greeting. No "welcome to The Columbia!" No "Hello" and certainly, no smile. No nothing except "You need a mask!!!!!!!!" 

Beware.. they are extremely worried about a virus with a survivability of only 99.97%.  Make sure you have your filthy cotton mouth covering on at all times because let me tell you, they're gonna reprimand the heck out of you if you don't. Even to stand up and drink your drink.

Atmosphere: A young and vibrant cafe! We went pre-COVID lockdowns. Mango Mango exudes youthful and fun energy perfect for casual group gatherings or a fresh place to study.

Service: We were a bit confused at first as to whether we would be waited for order or if we had to go up to a counter to order our food, so we initially sat down at a table close to the door. Our waiter was kind enough to move us to an upstairs seating area though!

Food: We ordered the strawberry mango juice sago & lychee jelly with mango ice cream. Although aesthetically pleasing, Mango Mango unfortunately did not meet our expectations in terms of food quality, and we didn't think our dessert was worth the price. The mango tasted super artificial, and the ice cream was a bit too sweet. We were disappointed because as mango lovers, we were super excited about the idea of a mango-themed dessert place. 

Overall: Mango Mango is a place you go for the experience rather than the desserts itself. The people and environment is very friendly and casual, but the dessert didn't live up to the hype the rest of the cafe had to offer.
65 beers on tap and right in the heart of Ybor city! Awesome staff. The impossible burger and impossible nachos are amazingly delicious. And lots of TVs to watch sports. Highly recommend !!

While the restaurant looks a little dingy from the outside and decor inside is quite outdated... the food is amazing!!!! I've tried a few of their dishes and have not been disappointed. Wait time for the food can take a little long depending on the time of the day. The owners are very friendly and helpful.

This place is living up to its fantastic reputation- great atmosphere, staff, and food.  I have been here several times now, and each time has been a huge success. I live a little ways away, or I would probably be there a lot more often. 

The pizza is amazing, but don't think of this place as a pizza place (I also missed out on the chance to eat here last time because I called it a pizza place and no one pizza).  They have an amazing full bar, great cocktails, and then the food. 

Everything I have tried is amazing.  Vegan options, meaty options, and everything in between.  Great Fried Green Tomatoes with pork belly, (as a veg I get the pork belly on the side -and become everyone in my party's best friend). The Skillet Garlic Knots are divine cheesy carbs at their best. 

I haven't tried the Rigatoni- but I've never seen anyone take home leftovers - including my buddy Matt who ordered the Rigatoni with Impossible Meatballs (instead of the normal short rib ragu). He didn't realize that Impossible meant vegan, he thought it meant impossible to beat. Still, he ate every bite. 

I recommend trying to have reservations if you can, they try hard to avoid them, but they always have a wait. So, do what you can to avoid it- you want to try this food.

It is Vanderbilt graduation week and we are in town for this last college celebration for our son.  Three of us had a wonderful dinner at Epice in the restaurant district which is hip and fun.  The decor is lovely with an inside or tent covered outside area with lovely event lighting.  I didn't see many exterior or interior shots so I included a few.  

Our party of three had:
Tabouli 
Hummus
Epice salad with salmon
Veal shank
Eggplant and beef with vermicelli rice
A bottle of the Cabernet blend 

The hostess and owner/manager were accommodating and welcoming.  The waiter was friendly, knowledgeable and professional.  But most of all the food was fresh, creatively prepared and excellent.  I love middle eastern food.  That said, this restaurant prepares the food in such a way that even a less adventurous diner would enjoy .  If you are not sure about Lebanese food, I would say give this a try .  I think this place has a really magical combination of positive things going on.  We have three more family members coming in tomorrow and I wish this was the restaurant I had picked for tomorrow night.

I understand we are eating outside, but no runs out here, very dirty with leaves, took awhile to get one drink or she forgot about it, her name was cecile, she was really nice- but my daughters hotdog was very gross! And I don't know why they aren't wearing a MASK! And I think it's very gross that I saw servers eating and licking their fingers!

Was taken here for my birthday: excellent service. Katrina was so helpful and kind: I'm very indecisive and she was able to help make me have a great time. She went the extra mile even helping me take the perfect picture of my birthday cheesecake . I will say sit by the bar with caution as I heard some very vulgar conversations. Other than that which the restaurant has no control of it was amazing. Tasty food and a nice atmosphere. Great for celebrating.
Just loved it. The place was beautiful oh, the service was wonderful and the only thing that I would like to have seen different was the French onion soup wasn't hot all those delicious.

They do not accept cash even if you have the exact amount! Place did not look clean. I went in for chips and salsa only and the cashier would not accept my cash and exact change! They do not deserve your business and I hope they go out of business.

We went to dinner last night and we're surprised by the difference from two years ago.   The downtown Ruth Chris restaurant does not reflect the brand we have loved over the years.   The bar takes up the majority of the restaurant now right in the middle so don't plan on having a nice, quiet dinner because every table and booth is around the bar.  The bar seat around 40 people at least.   Televisions were now added everywhere including in every booth!   So we sit down for a meal that cost around $250+ in a booth where we were treated to the WWE Smackdown until we asked the server to turn it off.  

The restaurant decor was old and dirty.  Dark, lots of red lights and feels like a cheap, chain restaurant.  

I love going to a sports bar just didn't expect it from Ruth Chris.  

The saving grace is that our waiter was excellent!!  And food was too!  Excellent.

We used to love going here for the salsa in a bottle and the yummy chili con queso dip. Ownership has changed and now it's just like every other mexican restaurant. Miss the old food as do many I know.

OMG this is the slowest drive through on the planet!  25 minutes to even place the order. WARNING:  DO NOT GO TO THIS PANERA!!!!  Have they ever heard of asking the top-large order at front of the line to go park while they wait so the other 20 customers could be served???

My husband and I were fortunate enough to be invited to a birthday party for a good friend of ours, Mrs Ly.
We had such an amazing time here.
The food was great! Especially the wings!
 I love the lemon pepper and the Parmesan ones as well.  The wrapped shrimp  are awesome! And ....oh my goodness, the Pho is magnificent!
I was bummed because I couldn't purchase any T-shirts as they were out of large and don't carry XXL....(which I hope they will consider doing as bigger people would love the shirts as well) 
I highly recommend this place!
We were actually able to partake in karaoke as well and it was also fun.
Just an all around great time!
 Great food and great people made for an all-around great time!
